topics.topic: Factory deployment route binding and whether its advisory policy is shared or separately versioned
questions: Does the deliverer reuse the Client Portal's advisory policy, or must the Factory hold a separate deliverer-specific policy with independently versioned values?

Which existing Factory route is authoritative, how this service is associated with it, and what distinguishes this service's advisory policy from the Client Portal's policy must be specified so deployment does not invent those bindings.

quotes:
2. The image library decodes untrusted files. Before each deployment every distribution installed
   in the image is checked against a snapshot of the OSV database, ecosystem PyPI, that the deployment route accepts
   as current. That route owns the age limit, and no code of this service reads it. Any known vulnerability listed for an installed version
   blocks the deployment, whatever its severity, and a check that cannot complete does not pass.
   This is the policy the Client Portal already follows.

A deployment of this service is admitted only through the Factory's deployment route for it, the route
the Client Portal follows, with this service's own advisory policy.

precedent.topic: Define PublicationMark.marked_at time source, representation, and read timing/count
quotes:
1. The system clock is the one source of the current time, declared as `rules.time_source_policy`
   and reaching code through `system_clock_backend` as the operation `utc_now`.

2. Only a mark reads it, once, after the token, the request form and the identifiers are accepted and
   before the connection is examined or the project lock is taken. A mark refused before that point does
   not read it. A mark refused after it, and a replayed mark, have read it and write nothing. Scan, delivery
   and the health answer never read it.

3. The current time is a `datetime` in UTC without an offset, with microsecond precision and no
   rounding, written in ISO 8601 form as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, followed by `.` and six digits when
   the microseconds are not zero, with no offset. Every instant of a record and an answer is written
   so. It sets `marked_at`.
precedent.why: A7 specifies the clock authority, exactly one read and its position, which refused and replayed marks read it, and the offset-free UTC representation assigned to marked_at.

precedent.topic: Whether deterministic stored bytes are guaranteed across all supported Linux environments or only one pinned build
quotes:
1. A stored image is a newly encoded JPEG made from the decoded pixels of the first frame of the source by
   exactly these operations of the image library at the version A9 pins, in this order, whose arithmetic
   (conversion formulas, resampling, rounding of sizes, alpha compositing and encoding) is that library's:
   its EXIF transposition applies the camera orientation; its conversion to RGBA converts the decoded
   samples, without colour management and without a colour profile; its thumbnail reduction with the
   LANCZOS filter to a box of the imported `PHOTO_MAX_SIDE` constant on each side reduces the image when a
   side is larger than that box, keeping its proportion; the result is pasted onto an RGB image of the same
   size filled with the colour of the imported `PHOTO_BACKGROUND` constant, with its own alpha channel as
   the mask, so transparent areas take that colour; and its JPEG encoding writes the image with quality the
   imported `PHOTO_QUALITY` constant, optimize the imported `PHOTO_OPTIMIZE` constant, progressive the
   imported `PHOTO_PROGRESSIVE` constant and subsampling the imported `PHOTO_SUBSAMPLING` constant, with no
   EXIF, colour profile or other metadata. With one library version one source gives the same bytes. `sha256`
   and `size` of M04 describe the bytes that were stored, its `media_type` is the imported `STORED_MEDIA_TYPE` constant, and a repeated delivery returns that placement
   without encoding again (A3 rule 2).

1. The direct libraries are pinned to exact versions: pillow, fastapi, pydantic and uvicorn. The
   libraries they require are resolved when the deployment image is built and are covered by rule 2.
precedent.why: The byte guarantee is stated without a build or architecture qualification and therefore requires the same source and pinned image-library version to produce the same bytes across supported environments.

topics.topic: Whether photo modification time is read once and reused during preparation or delivery
questions: During one preparation or delivery, is the file modification time read exactly once and reused for camera-time validation and fallback, or may it be read separately for those decisions?

judgement.why: P8 already judged that modification metadata is captured once from the opened file and the same value is reused for preparation, and the relevant passages did not change.

precedent.topic: Decide whether photo modification time is read once and reused during preparation
quotes: _read_source_bytes: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST open entry once, relative to the folder descriptor, for reading only, without blocking and without following a link, and judge the opened object before reading it: one that is not a regular file MUST raise Rejected with the NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE member of = models.PlacementFailure, and a failure to open, inspect or read it MUST raise Rejected with the UNREADABLE_FILE member. It MUST read from the start until the end of the file or one byte past the imported MAX_SOURCE_BYTES constant, whichever comes first, raise Rejected with the TOO_LARGE member when that byte is reached, and otherwise return every byte read together with the status of the opened file taken before reading; the file MUST be closed on every path and never opened again.

_observed: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST judge the rejection orders of A1 in their order: a file whose listed size in info says it holds no byte is rejected with the EMPTY member of = models.ObservationReason and one whose listed size is above the imported MAX_SOURCE_BYTES constant with the TOO_LARGE member, both before the file is opened; then it MUST call _read_source_bytes once, and a Rejected it raises is rejected with the reason of the row of the imported OBSERVATION_FAILURES constant whose failure is its reason, no bytes read with the EMPTY member and _signature_format returning None with the UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT member. A rejected SourceFile carries the REJECTED member of = models.ScanStatus, the given name, the listed size, the time _modified_at gives for info, no source id and no bytes; otherwise it MUST return a SourceFile with the READY member of = models.ScanStatus, the lowercase hexadecimal digest of the imported sha256 of the bytes as source_id, their length as size and the time _modified_at gives for the status of the read, together with those bytes.

_photo_moment: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the EXIF of the first frame of image once, a reading that fails counting as no EXIF, giving each tag value to _parse_exif_moment only when it is a string and None otherwise, and return the first moment _parse_exif_moment gives, judged against modified and read in zone, for the EXIF DateTimeOriginal tag of the Exif directory with its OffsetTimeOriginal tag, then for the EXIF DateTime tag of the first directory with no offset, paired with the EXIF member of = models.DateSource; when neither gives one it MUST return modified unchanged with the FILE_MODIFIED member of = models.DateSource. It MUST NOT read the service clock.

_place: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST call the imported prepare_photo with raw, the modified of source and the timezone of context, then the imported store_image with its content, then the imported build_publication, and write with the imported write_placement a PhotoPlacement of the project id and source id, the name of source, the reference store_image returned, the lowercase hexadecimal digest of the imported sha256 of the stored bytes and their length, the imported STORED_MEDIA_TYPE constant as media_type, the date_source of the prepared photo and the publication, returning that placement; an exception raised by any of these calls MUST pass to the caller unchanged.
precedent.why: The State 7 notes capture modification metadata from the opened file, carry that single modified value into preparation, and use the same value for both plausibility checks and fallback.
